Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F05
Accountable role (person unassigned): Frontend/integration engineer
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: A signed-in user finds permitted projects/datasets and manages collaboration without typing internal IDs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Implement bounded authorized directory/search APIs and console navigation from login through lab/project/dataset to existing release and curation screens.
2. Provide human-readable collaborator selection, effective-access explanation, scope/future-release distinction, expiry and revocation under the same backend contracts.
3. Include empty/denied/error/stale-session states, keyboard/focus behavior and leakage checks for titles, counts and suggestions; do not duplicate authority rules in the browser.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
